title: 1991 radio caller: underground work alongside alien-like beings
place_text: Underground test site, Nevada (Las Vegas radio)

tellings.quote: 1991, a caller into a Las Vegas radio show claimed he was hired to run electricity 3,000 ft underground on a certain test site, a job that came through Reynolds Electronics, an EG subsidiary. [music] He also said that military personnel were working alongside beings that resembled aliens.

plain: In 1991, a caller to a Las Vegas radio show said he had been hired to run electricity 3,000 feet underground at a test site in Nevada, through a company he named as Reynolds Electronics, a subsidiary of a firm called EG, and that he saw military personnel "working alongside beings that resembled aliens." Michels tells this himself on the show, without naming where he heard the broadcast. If true, it would mean humans and non-human beings were working together at a secret underground government site.
